shellCommands.command: for f in pages/*.js pages/blog/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js; do echo "===== $f"; cat "$f"; done
find components styles __agent_eval__ -maxdepth 4 -type f -print; cat tsconfig.json next.config.ts .gitignore
git ls-files && test -d node_modules && echo node_modules-present || true; git diff -- package.json
git status --short; test ! -d pages && echo 'pages removed'; rg 'next/router|next/head|next/document|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps' app components lib || true
git status --short; git diff --check; test ! -d pages && echo 'pages directory absent'
